# BackBond public evidence client (analysis not included)

This package validates claims, hashes explicitly supplied artifacts, creates capture receipts, and bridges to a separately distributed private analyzer.

It is not a standalone scan or quick exposure check. It does not contain scoring, classification, detector, calibration, or policy-decision logic. Without a SHA-256-pinned private analyzer, treat `analysis_required` as fail-closed and do not enable privileged tools from self-authored claims.

Analyzer invocation executes the supplied file with the current user's permissions. A matching caller-supplied SHA-256 pin establishes byte identity only, not publisher authenticity or safety. Never accept an analyzer path and digest pair from an untrusted prompt.

Network publication requires explicit `--publish`.
